alex: Heads-up — planning a soft launch for `llama3q-c-lite` tomorrow 07:00 UTC. I want to preemptively pin runtime 3.1 on the canary region to avoid known perf regressions on long-seqs. any objections?
mina: +1 on cautious approach. Can we cordon the rollout (no autoscale) instead of a hard pin? Easier rollback if traffic spike.
sam: Cordon helps but runtime pin prevents accidental routing from older shims. If we cordon, confirm deploybot routing rules will still prefer pinned runtime.
lia: We should also pin SDK to 2.14 for canary clients — last SDK has a tokenizer change that caused minor diffs in evals. Recommend `sdk:2.14` + `runtime:3.1` together.
jen: What's our rollback signal? CPU/GPU p99 > 2x baseline? Token drop or hallucination regressions on our smoke prompt set? Need precise gates.
alex: Good call. Proposed rollback criteria:
- latency p50 > 1.8x baseline OR p99 > 2x baseline for 15m
- error rate increase > 0.5% absolute for 10m
- quality regression: automated eval NLI delta > 3% on smoke-set OR customer-facing halluc rate triaged by SRE
If any trigger, we rollback runtime pin and route to `llama3q-c-compat`.
mina: Agree. Also add a manual abort button for oncall to immediately unpin if needed.
sam: I'll add a short runbook snippet. paste below once done.
deploybot: deploybot scheduled: planning window created for 2026-03-22T07:00:00Z -> 2026-03-22T09:00:00Z (canary: eu-west-1). Rolling strategy: phased 10% -> 50% -> 100% if metrics stable.
lia: runbook draft:```
1) Observe metrics in /dash/canary/llama3q-c-lite for 30m after initial 10%
2) If no regressions, increase to 50% and observe 30m
3) If any rollback criteria hit, run: `deployctl unpin --runtime 3.1 --region eu-west-1` and `deployctl route --model llama3q-c-lite --target llama3q-c-compat`
4) Notify #incidents and the oncall engineer, open a postmortem if customer impact > P2
```
jen: Add holding page for customers in case we need immediate fallback to compat. ops can push it in <5m.
alex: OK set of actions:
- @sam add runbook to runbook repo and link here
- @mina will cordon autoscaling for canary before launch
- @lia will pin SDK 2.14 for canary clients (feature-flagged)
- @jen will prepare holding page + notify comms if rollback happens
- I'll request the deploybot pin command at T-30min (manual).
sam: done, runbook PR: https://git.internal/r/infra/runbooks/pulls/1243 — includes exact commands and dashboards.
deploybot: deploybot notice: pin command preview:
```
# preview only
deployctl pin --runtime 3.1 --region eu-west-1 --models llama3q-c-lite --reason "softlaunch cordon" --no-autoscale
```
alex: Perfect. If no objections by EOD I'll push for T-30min manual pin. :thumbsup:
mina: no objections from me. :+1:
jen: ok from comms side.
lia: good to go.
deploybot: deploybot: scheduled reminder set for 2026-03-22T06:30:00Z (T-30m).
